title: Uniform-sign coordinate noise
statement: Let $\rho\in[0,1]$ and let $x$ be a sign, that is, an element of $\{ -1,1\}$. The coordinate noise distribution obtained by using the uniform sign distribution as the resampling law is equal to the coordinate resampling noise distribution with parameter $\rho$ at $x$.
